description: CFD 2D wave tank with PLIC VOF (F 80 4) on a domain from z = -0.5 to 0.5, still water level F 60 0.0 (wave theory depth B 94 0.5), relaxation zone (2 m) and beach (B 99 2, 4 m). Before IOWAVE patch 0065 vof_relax took the column's water depth above z_min (0.5 m) as the height of its surface, against the target eta + 0.0: the zones filled towards z = 0.5.
